component.name: Layout
component.description: Single shared HTML shell. Sets head metadata (title, description, OG/Twitter, canonical, sitemap), preloads Quantico + Fontshare Nippo, runs the anti-flash dark-mode bootstrap, and exposes a single <slot/> for page content.

useCases: set per-page SEO metadata (title, description, OG image)
opt a page out of indexing via noindex

commonPatterns.name: homepage
commonPatterns.description: Default site-wide title and description; OG image falls back to /images/payxpert.webp.

commonPatterns.name: project page
commonPatterns.description: Pass project-specific title, description, and OG image for shareable previews.

commonPatterns.name: hidden page
commonPatterns.description: Use noindex for unlisted utility pages so they stay out of search results.

antiPatterns.reason: Produces nested <html> / <head> and breaks the head metadata contract.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Layout once per page at the top level only.

antiPatterns.scenario: rendering global <head> tags inside page bodies
antiPatterns.reason: Layout owns the document head; duplicate tags will conflict (canonical, theme-color, og:*).
antiPatterns.alternative: Add new head tags inside Layout.astro behind a prop.

antiPatterns.scenario: moving the anti-flash theme script out of Layout head
antiPatterns.reason: It must run before paint to avoid a light/dark flash.
antiPatterns.alternative: Keep it inline in Layout head; only the toggle handler script can move.

parentConstraints: must be the outermost component on a page

interactions.themeToggle: Bottom-of-body inline script wires every .theme-toggle button to flip data-theme on <html> and persist to localStorage under key 'theme'.

title.default: Daniel Grita | Graphic and Web Design based in Barcelona

aiHints.context: Always wrap new pages in this. Do not re-implement document head or theme bootstrap.
